Fortress Clear Anti-Slip Decking Stain provides a robust water-based solution for outdoor timber decking, ensuring essential protection and enhancement. This quick-drying formula, touch-dry in just two hours and recoatable in four, is efficient for trade professionals on various projects. It offers strong resistance to water and UV damage, helping to keep timber decking nourished and protected against the elements in high-traffic garden and patio areas. With integrated anti-slip properties, this stain enhances safety, while its clear finish allows the natural beauty of the wood to remain visible. A 2.5Ltr tub covers up to 25m², making it a practical choice for durable outdoor wood treatment.
